_doc: Project settings read by the engine and the tools. mode: solo | team (references/01). timing: offset > 0 shows every picture later; lyricOffset > 0 moves only the lyrics (core/cues.js). render.shutter: motion blur, samples 1 = off (core/cues.js). review: tolerances of tools/storyboard.mjs and the checks (references/09 section 7).
